Use Rich’s `Live` display to update one terminal line repeatedly: [Live docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst). `rich.print()` renders strings as Rich text, which strips carriage returns; flushing writes the output but does not make `\r` a cursor command. For usage questions, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
